description: The bar chart titled “Recall@10” illustrates Recall@10 values for four method variants. The category axis is horizontal, showing the labels “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking” in that left-to-right order, with the labels angled; no explicit x-axis label is shown. The value axis is vertical with a linear scale, spanning approximately 0.1 to 0.4, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals (0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4). There are four single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars: “Ours” is colored brown/gold and reaches about 0.35; “- critiquing” is blue-gray and reaches about 0.29; “- scoring” is blue-gray and reaches about 0.17; and “- ranking” is blue-gray and reaches about 0.235. The bars are not shown as sorted by value, and “Ours” is visually emphasized by a distinct color compared with the other three bars, which share the same blue-gray color; no additional annotations or outlines are present.
